explanation: This feature is 0 almost everywhere: at every D1 and D2 step, and at every GO in the first ~65 trials or after trial ~88. It spikes to about 10 only at the GO step of the first unrewarded trial after a rewarded one (D1 shows no reward, but the trial before that was rewarded), and only between about trials 68 and 85; even then it fires only some of the time, and a second unrewarded trial in a row gives 0 to 1.
